findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 4 requests to 2 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 8.4 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 291 kB (3%) came from third-party domains, 291 kB of it from services classified as tracking (4 requests).

2 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising).
With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 3 requests were blocked. The page still made 4 requests to 2 third-party domains, including 2 tracking services in our list.
